researchQuestion: When the same tool-using agent receives different representations of the same user history, where—if anywhere—does its observable single-turn trajectory first diverge after memory exposure?

temporalDesign.memoryCutoff: 2:36 pm on Saturday, 28 October 2023 at D26:20
temporalDesign.boundary: The memory representations contain only pre-cutoff evidence. The held-out workspace contains synthetic current evidence recorded after the memory cutoff.

intervention.assignmentBoundary: Condition assignment occurs when exactly one representation is copied to memory.md in an otherwise identical fresh workspace.

exposureBoundary.expectedOperation: A recorded command or tool operation reads memory.md before the other evidence files.
exposureBoundary.observedWhen: The runtime records a completed read whose inspectable path or command evidence identifies memory.md.
exposureBoundary.notExposedWhen: No recorded operation reads memory.md before the final artifact is written.
exposureBoundary.ambiguousWhen: The available event evidence cannot establish whether or when memory.md was read.
exposureBoundary.downstreamComparisonStartsAfter: The completed exposure operation or exposure span.

runtimeControls.workingDirectoryLayout: identical fresh materialized workspace per run

materializedWorkspace.immutabilityRule: All files except proposal.md must retain their initial checksum during a run.
materializedWorkspace.crossConditionRule: Before a run, every file except memory.md must be byte-identical across M1, M2, and M3 workspaces.

runPlan.retryPolicy: Never silently retry a failed model turn. Preserve incomplete and failed runs as results.

successChecks: The assigned representation is installed at memory.md with the expected checksum.
The runtime exposes or explicitly fails to expose memory.md.
The fixed 11:30-14:00 commitment remains unchanged in the proposal.
The proposal includes at least 60 minutes of Monday preparation.
No source file other than proposal.md changes.
privacyAndLeakageRules: Do not copy locomodata/ or any full LoCoMo conversation into a run workspace.
Do not include post-D26:20 dialogue in memory.md.
Do not include absolute personal filesystem paths in committed fixtures or public traces.
Do not include credentials, external account identifiers, or real bookings.
Label the LoCoMo history as generated public research data and the current workspace as synthetic.
claimBoundary: This is a controlled, case-specific representation intervention. Observed differences may be described as post-exposure trajectory differences, not as proof that a representation caused the final behavior or as a population-level memory effect.
